title: Tech Note: Merging Data from Remote Datastores into a Local Database
author: Mehdi AARAB, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Morocco.

historical_commentary.text: Still fully current: ORDA remote datastores (via Open datastore over REST) remain a supported, standard 4D feature for cross-database data access, and this cross-datastore merge pattern is still valid practice today.
related_updates: ORDA remote datastore access (Open datastore, introduced with 4D's REST server in v18) has not been superseded and remains the recommended way to connect separately-hosted 4D databases together.
4D View Pro (used here for reporting) remains the current spreadsheet/reporting component, having long since replaced classic 4D View.
